plan.description: Freeze and hash the endpoint, baseline groups, censoring, ties and thresholds before table admission.
Admit immutable synthetic subject identities, time units, flags and baseline assignment times.
Refuse leakage, duplicates, inconsistent flags, insufficient events and excess censoring imbalance.
Compute Kaplan-Meier uncertainty, log-rank and an explicitly exploratory O/E ratio.
Register ordinary artifacts and separate claims for coordinator-owned independent review.
